goal: Improve correct PSI readout coverage under dim, backlit/reflected, mild side-view and partially obstructed conditions
user_priority: Predicted hub and needle direction remain displayable independently of numeric read permission; final outcome is a pressure reading or a stated adjustment/rejection reason
scope: Offline PC/ROI development and necessary integer-cost reasoning; no board/MCU/OSD/Flash changes
learning_budget: One fixed robust hub warm-training run, then one fixed polar run using that actual hub on the same augmented inputs; existing1202+1009 inference architecture retained
nonlearning_pose_budget: At most two ROI128-only static-print pose candidates with train-only templates and fit; native-frame SIFT remains comparator only
augmentation: Controlled gamma/shadow/highlight/blur with actual label evidence preserved or per-head supervision ignored; no forced labels behind opaque covers
calibration: Train visual needle angles and user PSI only; no pressure-to-point inversion, no G fitting, no unknown pose treated as zero
comparison: Separate model-only changes from ROI-only pose and combined readout; use all56 gauge images plus3 negatives, including failures
metrics: Hub error and needle direction by scene
PSI mean/median/max absolute error on outputs
Newly correct outputs and newly wrong outputs by ID
constraints: No threshold relaxation concealed as robustness
No native image supplied to a claimed ROI-only runtime
No synthetic/historical data called independent real test
No model/MCU/board acceptance by PC results alone
Preserve successful old candidates and simultaneous OSD work
